decisions.reason: Submarine interior lighting is a very narrow niche and only lightly featured on the website, but it fits the firm's maritime customer base and a large expanding R&D-led firm would usually keep such an option open a bit longer while market potential remains uncertain.

The medical examination light is somewhat adjacent to the core lighting business yet was given its own product page, so management would likely continue to test this professional niche rather than exit immediately.

Explosion-proof industrial luminaires closely match the firm's industrial focus, engineering strengths and certification capabilities, making this a strong strategic fit that is unlikely to be withdrawn soon.

The designer task light is less central than industrial and maritime products, but its relaunch as a popular product and continued standalone presentation suggest enough traction to justify keeping it on the market.
